logicalBugs.description: A date/time filter selects rows by a calendar date or an interval; the picker’s displayed dates and preview should describe the timestamps actually included. Compare a relative date/time picker’s preview with the rows returned after applying it. Server relative-date evaluation uses the query/report/database timezone. Near a day boundary these different clocks produce different calendar dates for yesterday/previous-day previews and results. The available source does not establish that every such endpoint variant shares this timezone mechanism; those variants retain provisional attribution rather than being equated solely by symptom. This is a source-informed hypothesis; the exact mechanism has not been confirmed in execution. This analysis uses approximate public source because the fixture’s exact runtime source revision was unavailable.
